author: Sarah Scott
description: "A Description of Millenium Hall" by Sarah Scott is a utopian novel published in 1762.
longDescription: Two male travelers stumble upon a secluded estate inhabited by an extraordinary community of unmarried women who have rejected patriarchal society.

authorInfo.bio:
Sarah Scott (1723–1795) wrote A Description of Millenium Hall
And the Country Adjacent Together with the Characters of the Inhabitants and Such Historical Anecdotes and Reflections As May Excite in the Reader Proper Sentiments of Humanity, and Lead the Mind to the Love of Virtue. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
